Quick totals (manual): est_hours_sum = 49 (treat as rough). Coverage confidence: 2 Low / 3 Medium / 1 High.

Notes to self: use this sheet in slack thread #micro-triage, add a line whenever a 72-hour urgent ask appears. After coverage confirmed, move row to confluence canonical list.

Open questions: 1) Do we lock in finance approval path for Dedicated bursts (Miguel + Aisha)? 2) Can Legal pre-approve a sanitized example for Solutions-eng pilots?

Action checklist (short):
- [ ] Sync with finance (Aisha) by EOD 2026-03-12
- [ ] Drop observability prototype link in slack (Miguel)
- [ ] Create KMS onboarding stub (Jonah)
- [ ] Run nightly micro-bench for serving-runtime repro (Claire)

Escalation notes: If any row moves to urgency 5 with >12 est hrs, tag @oncall-sre and product-ops-rotation and escalate to weekly standup if unresolved after 24h.
